name: Quiet and precise
character: Your choices lean toward a quiet, precise look: restrained typography, generous space, and clear detail. Nothing shouts, everything sits where it belongs, and the work is left to speak for itself.
say: What you do, what it costs, when it's ready.
mood: Off-white, ink, one cool accent; one restrained typeface, generous space, small type held together by alignment.

example.headline: Glasses that fit the way you read.

name: Warm and handmade
character: Your choices lean toward a warm, handmade look: tactile materials, softer edges, and personal language. Things look touched by a person, not produced by a system.
say: Who made it, who's behind the counter, come in and try.
mood: Paper, clay, deep green; one typeface with visible character, softer edges, text set like a note.

example.headline: Come in and taste before you decide.

name: Bold and direct
character: Your choices lean toward a bold, direct look: strong contrast, large type, and short messages. Plain words, one idea at a time, no hedging.
say: The offer and the benefit in under eight words.
avoid: Qualifiers, long sentences, three ideas in one line.
mood: One saturated colour plus black; heavy weights, tight leading, big first line.
